+  /** Copies the report bytes to the data lake's semantic-context (`rag/`) prefix, put-if-absent.
+    * The result names the object by its logical location (`s3://{data-bucket}/KEY`); it never fails
+    * the job silently: every outcome is recorded.
+    */
+  private def copyReport(
+      bytes: Array[Byte],
+      cfg: Option[StorageConfig],
+      env: Option[IngestStores],
+      runId: Option[RunId],
+      masking: Masking
+  ): ujson.Obj = {
+    val sha = Hashing.sha256Hex(bytes)
+    val base = ujson.Obj(
+      "format" -> ReportCopyFormat,
+      "formatVersion" -> 1,
+      "sha256" -> sha,
+      "bytes" -> bytes.length.toDouble
+    )
+    def outcome(obj: String, o: String): ujson.Obj = {
+      base("object") = obj
+      base("outcome") = o
+      base
+    }
+    (cfg.flatMap(_.zones.get("semantic-context")), env) match {
+      case (None, _) =>
+        outcome("-", "not attempted: the semantic-context zone is not configured")
+      case (_, None)                  => outcome("-", "not attempted: the stores were not built")
+      case (Some(zone), Some(stores)) =>
+        val ref = ObjectRef(zone.bucket, reportCopyKey(zone.prefix, runId, sha))
+        val logical = s"s3://${Masking.DataBucket}/${ref.key}"
+        try
+          stores.objects.putIfAbsent(
+            ref,
+            bytes,
+            "application/json",
+            Map(ObjectStore.Sha256MetadataKey -> sha)
+          ) match {
+            case PutOutcome.Created        => outcome(logical, "created")
+            case PutOutcome.AlreadyPresent => outcome(logical, "already present")
+            case PutOutcome.Conflict(_)    =>
+              outcome(logical, "conflict: an object with other bytes exists; nothing written")
+          }
+        catch {
+          case NonFatal(e) =>
+            outcome(
+              logical,
+              masking(s"failed: ${e.getClass.getSimpleName}: ${Option(e.getMessage).getOrElse("")}")
+            )
+        }
     }
-    report
   }

   test("argument parsing") {

+  // ---- Phase 13 decision 7 and 7b ---------------------------------------------------------------
+
+  test("decision 7: the option constant has exactly these names") {
+    assertEquals(RagIngestJob.Required, List("config", "export", "out", "code-version"))
+    assertEquals(RagIngestJob.Optional, List("stores", "runs", "samples-per-index"))
+  }
+
+  test("decision 7: the parser accepts exactly the constant's names and refuses the rest") {
+    val all = (RagIngestJob.Required ++ RagIngestJob.Optional).flatMap { n =>
+      List(
+        s"--$n",
+        n match {
+          case "stores"            => "aws"
+          case "runs"              => "1"
+          case "samples-per-index" => "3"
+          case "code-version"      => "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567"
+          case "export"            => "s3://example-graph-bucket/graph/exports/run=" + "0" * 32
+          case other               => other
+        }
+      )
+    }
+    val ok = RagIngestJob.parse(all.toArray).fold(fail(_), identity)
+    assertEquals(ok.codeVersion, "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567")
+    assertEquals(ok.exportLocation, "s3://example-graph-bucket/graph/exports/run=" + "0" * 32)
+    // every required name is required
+    RagIngestJob.Required.foreach { n =>
+      val i = all.indexOf(s"--$n")
+      val without = (all.take(i) ++ all.drop(i + 2)).toArray
+      assertEquals(RagIngestJob.parse(without), Left(s"--$n is required"), n)
+    }
+    // unknown, repeated, positional and malformed values are refused
+    val unknown = RagIngestJob.parse((all ++ List("--export-dir", "x")).toArray)
+    assert(unknown.left.exists(_.contains("unknown options: --export-dir")), unknown.toString)
+    val repeated = RagIngestJob.parse((all ++ List("--runs", "2")).toArray)
+    assert(repeated.left.exists(_.contains("repeated options: --runs")), repeated.toString)
+    assert(RagIngestJob.parse((all ++ List("runs", "2")).toArray).isLeft)
+    assert(RagIngestJob.parse((all :+ "--runs").toArray).isLeft)
+    val badCode = all.updated(all.indexOf("--code-version") + 1, "has space")
+    assert(RagIngestJob.parse(badCode.toArray).left.exists(_.contains("--code-version")))
+    val badStores = all.updated(all.indexOf("--stores") + 1, "s3")
+    assertEquals(RagIngestJob.parse(badStores.toArray), Left("--stores must be local or aws"))
+    // an s3:// export needs the AWS stores (the local stores hold no data lake)
+    val s3Local = all.updated(all.indexOf("--stores") + 1, "local")
+    assertEquals(RagIngestJob.parse(s3Local.toArray), Left("an s3:// export needs --stores aws"))
+  }
+
+  test(
+    "decision 7: --code-version and the build identity are recorded; CodeVersion keeps its role"
+  ) {
+    val root = Files.createTempDirectory("rag-job-code")

+      "services",

+    )

+    assertEquals(r("status").str, "completed", r.render(indent = 2))
+    assertEquals(r("codeVersion").str, TestCodeVersion)
+    assertEquals(r("jobCodeVersion").str, "rag/1")
+    assertEquals(RagIngestJob.CodeVersion, "rag/1")

+    // the run ID still derives from the job's CodeVersion, not from --code-version
+    val other = parseOk(

+    )
+    val r2 = RagIngestJob.run(other)
+    assertEquals(r2("runId").str, r("runId").str)
+    assertEquals(r2("codeVersion").str, "fedcba9876543210fedcba9876543210fedcba98")
+    // in module tests the jar resource is absent: the identity says so, it is never invented
+    assertEquals(r2("build")("buildCommit").str, "unknown")
+    assertEquals(r2("build")("status").str, "missing")
+    // local stores: no copy to the data lake
+    assert(!Files.exists(root.resolve("a").resolve("run-report-copy.json")))
+  }

+  /** A voyage stub transport that answers with the fake lexical vectors (no network). */
+  private def voyageWiring: org.scholarchain.rag.embedding.EmbeddingProviders.Wiring = {

+      httpTransport = () => stub

+
+  private final case class S3Fixture(
+      root: Path,
+      out: Path,
+      localExport: Path,
+      exportKey: String,
+      ragBucket: String,
+      ragPrefix: String,
+      env: org.scholarchain.storage.local.LocalStorageEnvironment,
+      result: RagIngestJob.JobResult,
+      printed: List[String],
+      wiring: org.scholarchain.rag.embedding.EmbeddingProviders.Wiring
+  ) {
+
+    /** A stores factory over a fresh in-memory environment (for a second, local-export run). */
+    def factory(): (
+        org.scholarchain.storage.StorageConfig,
+        String,
+        Path
+    ) => Either[String, RagIngestJob.IngestStores] =
+      (cfg, _, _) =>
+        Right(
+          new RagIngestJob.LocalIngestStores(
+            org.scholarchain.storage.local.LocalStorageEnvironment.create(cfg, None),
+            kind = "aws"
+          )
+        )
+  }
+
+  /** Copies the fixture export into the in-memory object store under the graph zone, then runs the
+    * job with `--stores aws` over that store (stub AWS stores, stub voyage transport).
+    *
+    * @param skip
+    *   relative paths to leave out of the store (`FIRST_FILE` = the first listed data file)
+    */
+  private def s3Fixture(
+      bucket: String = "",
+      skip: Set[String] = Set.empty,
+      changeFirstFile: Boolean = false
+  ): S3Fixture = {
+    import org.scholarchain.storage.ports.ObjectRef
+    val root = Files.createTempDirectory("rag-job-s3")
+    val local = writeExport(root.resolve("export"))
+    val cfg = storageConfigOf("rag-voyage-example-v1.json")
+    val graph = cfg.zones("graph")
+    val exportBucket = if (bucket.isEmpty) graph.bucket else bucket
+    val exportKey = s"${graph.prefix}/exports/${local.getFileName}"
+    val env = org.scholarchain.storage.local.LocalStorageEnvironment.create(cfg, None)
+    val files = {
+      val s = Files.walk(local)
+      try
+        s.filter(Files.isRegularFile(_))
+          .toArray
+          .toList
+          .map(_.asInstanceOf[Path])
+          .map(p => local.relativize(p).toString.replace('\\', '/') -> p)
+          .sortBy(_._1)
+      finally s.close()
+    }
+    val firstData = files.map(_._1).find(_ != "_export_manifest.json").get
+    val left = skip.map(p => if (p == "FIRST_FILE") firstData else p)
+    files.filterNot(f => left(f._1)).foreach { case (rel, p) =>
+      val bytes0 = Files.readAllBytes(p)
+      val bytes =
+        if (changeFirstFile && rel == firstData) {
+          val b = bytes0.clone(); b(0) = (b(0) ^ 0x01).toByte; b
+        } else bytes0
+      env.objects.putIfAbsent(
+        ObjectRef(exportBucket, s"$exportKey/$rel"),
+        bytes,
+        "text/plain",
+        Map()
+      )
+    }
+    val printed = scala.collection.mutable.ListBuffer.empty[String]
+    val out = root.resolve("attempt-01")
+    val wiring = voyageWiring
+    val opts = parseOk(
+      Array(
+        "--config",
+        configPath("rag-voyage-example-v1.json").toString,
+        "--export",
+        s"s3://$exportBucket/$exportKey",
+        "--out",
+        out.toString,
+        "--code-version",
+        TestCodeVersion,
+        "--runs",
+        "1",
+        "--samples-per-index",
+        "3",
+        "--stores",
+        "aws"
+      )
+    )
+    val result = RagIngestJob.execute(
+      opts,
+      (_, _, _) => Right(new RagIngestJob.LocalIngestStores(env, kind = "aws")),
+      wiring,
+      RagIngestJob.Hooks(print = s => printed += s)
+    )
+    val rag = cfg.zones("semantic-context")
+    S3Fixture(
+      root,
+      out,
+      local,
+      exportKey,
+      rag.bucket,
+      rag.prefix,
+      env,
+      result,
+      printed.toList,
+      wiring
     )
   }

   val ReportName = "_export_report.json"

+  /** Required options of the entry point (without the `--` prefix); the scripts' contract. */
+  val Required: List[String] = List("source-run", "out-root")
+
+  /** Optional options of the entry point (without the `--` prefix). */
+  val Optional: List[String] = List("records-per-file", "code-version")
+
+  val DefaultRecordsPerFile: Long = 250000L
+
+  /** Allowed `--code-version` text (a build commit, a tag or a short label; never a path). */
+  val CodeVersionPattern: Regex = "[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._+-]{0,99}".r
+
+  final case class Args(
+      sourceRun: Path,
+      outRoot: Path,
+      recordsPerFile: Long,
+      codeVersion: Option[String]
+  )
+
+  /** Parses `--name value` pairs against [[Required]] and [[Optional]]. Refuses an odd count, a
+    * name without `--`, a repeated or unknown name, a missing required name and an invalid value.
+    * Values are never echoed in the messages.
+    */
+  def parseArgs(argv: Seq[String]): Either[String, Args] = {
+    def path(k: String, v: String): Either[String, Path] =
+      try {
+        if (v.trim.isEmpty) Left(s"--$k is empty") else Right(new Path(v))
+      } catch { case NonFatal(_) => Left(s"--$k is not a valid path or URI") }
+    for {
+      _ <- if (argv.size % 2 == 0) Right(()) else Left("arguments must be --name value pairs")
+      pairs <- argv
+        .grouped(2)
+        .toList
+        .foldLeft[Either[String, List[(String, String)]]](Right(Nil)) {
+          case (Right(acc), Seq(k, v)) if k.startsWith("--") => Right(acc :+ (k.drop(2) -> v))
+          case (Right(_), Seq(_, _)) => Left("expected --name before each value")
+          case (left, _)             => left
+        }
+      names = pairs.map(_._1)
+      dup = names.diff(names.distinct).distinct
+      _ <- if (dup.isEmpty) Right(()) else Left(s"repeated arguments: ${dup.mkString(", ")}")
+      unknown = names.filterNot(n => Required.contains(n) || Optional.contains(n))
+      _ <- if (unknown.isEmpty) Right(()) else Left(s"unknown arguments: ${unknown.mkString(", ")}")
+      missing = Required.filterNot(names.contains)
+      _ <-
+        if (missing.isEmpty) Right(())
+        else Left(s"missing arguments: ${missing.map("--" + _).mkString(", ")}")
+      m = pairs.toMap
+      s <- path("source-run", m("source-run"))
+      o <- path("out-root", m("out-root"))
+      n <- m.get("records-per-file") match {
+        case None    => Right(DefaultRecordsPerFile)
+        case Some(v) =>
+          scala.util.Try(v.toLong).toOption.filter(_ > 0).toRight("--records-per-file must be > 0")
+      }
+      v <- m.get("code-version") match {
+        case None    => Right(None)
+        case Some(x) =>
+          if (CodeVersionPattern.pattern.matcher(x).matches()) Right(Some(x))
+          else Left(s"--code-version must match ${CodeVersionPattern.regex}")
+      }
+    } yield Args(s, o, n, v)
+  }
+
+  private val S3Authority = "(s3[an]?://)[^/\\s\"']+".r
+  private val ArnAccount = "(arn:[a-z0-9-]+:[a-z0-9-]+:[a-z0-9-]*:)[0-9]{12}:".r
+
+  /** A printable location: the plain path for `file:` paths; otherwise the authority (bucket or
+    * name node) is masked: `s3://{data-bucket}/KEY`, `hdfs://{authority}/PATH`.
+    */
+  def show(p: Path): String = {
+    val u = p.toUri
+    Option(u.getScheme) match {
+      case None | Some("file")             => u.getPath
+      case Some(s) if s.matches("s3[an]?") => s"$s://{data-bucket}${u.getPath}"
+      case Some(s)                         => s"$s://{authority}${u.getPath}"
+    }
+  }
+
+  /** Masks bucket names (`s3://NAME/`, and every literal name in `authorities`) and the account in
+    * ARNs, for messages that leave the job.
+    */
+  def maskText(text: String, authorities: Seq[String] = Nil): String = {
+    val known = authorities.filter(a => a != null && a.nonEmpty).distinct.sortBy(-_.length)
+    val a = known.foldLeft(text)((t, x) => t.replace(x, "{data-bucket}"))
+    val b = S3Authority.replaceAllIn(a, m => Regex.quoteReplacement(m.group(1) + "{data-bucket}"))
+    ArnAccount.replaceAllIn(b, m => Regex.quoteReplacement(m.group(1) + "{account}:"))
+  }
+
+  private def authorityOf(p: Path): Option[String] =
+    Option(p.toUri.getScheme).filterNot(_ == "file").flatMap(_ => Option(p.toUri.getAuthority))

+  private def fileHashes(dir: File): Map[String, String] = {
+    val all = Files.walk(dir.toPath)
+    try
+      all
+        .iterator()
+        .asScala
+        .filter(Files.isRegularFile(_))
+        .map { p =>
+          dir.toPath.relativize(p).toString -> Files2.sha256(p.toFile)
+        }
+        .toMap
+    finally all.close()
+  }

+final case class ExportCheck(files: Int, bytes: Long)

+/** Where an export lives: a local directory ([[LocalDirectorySource]]) or an S3 prefix read through
+  * the object-store port ([[S3ExportSource]]). Paths are relative to the export run directory
+  * (`run=<hex>/`). Both kinds make the same checks: the manifest must be present and well formed,
+  * every listed file must exist with the manifest's byte count ([[checkPresence]]), and every byte
+  * read is checked against the manifest's size and sha256 ([[lines]] at the end of each file,
+  * [[verifyAll]] for the whole export).
   */

-  protected def open(relativePath: String): InputStream

-      finally in.close()

+  protected def find(relativePath: String): Option[InputStream]
+
+  /** The byte size of the file at a relative path, or None when it does not exist. */
+  protected def sizeOf(relativePath: String): Option[Long]
+
+  protected final def checkedPath(relativePath: String): String = {
+    if (
+      relativePath == null || relativePath.isEmpty || relativePath.startsWith("/") ||
+      relativePath.split('/').exists(s => s.isEmpty || s == "." || s == "..")
+    )
+      throw new ExportSourceException(s"refusing path '$relativePath'")
+    relativePath
+  }
+
+  protected final def open(relativePath: String): InputStream =
+    find(checkedPath(relativePath)).getOrElse(
+      throw new ExportSourceException(s"$describe: missing export file $relativePath")
+    )
+
+  /** The raw bytes of `_export_manifest.json`; a missing manifest is an [[ExportSourceException]].
+    */
+  def manifestBytes(): Array[Byte] = {
+    val in = find(ExportManifest.FileName).getOrElse(
+      throw new ExportSourceException(
+        s"$describe: export manifest ${ExportManifest.FileName} is missing"
+      )
+    )
+    try in.readAllBytes()
+    finally in.close()
+  }

+  def manifest(): ExportManifest = parseManifest(manifestBytes())
+
+  /** The manifest and the hex sha256 of its bytes (the input fingerprint of a load). */
+  def manifestWithSha256(): (ExportManifest, String) = {
+    val bytes = manifestBytes()
+    (parseManifest(bytes), org.scholarchain.core.Hashing.sha256Hex(bytes))
+  }

+      .parse(new String(bytes, StandardCharsets.UTF_8))
       .fold(e => throw new ExportSourceException(s"$describe: $e"), identity)

+  /** Every listed file exists and has the manifest's byte count. Reads no content (one size lookup
+    * per file); fails on the first problem.
+    */
+  def checkPresence(m: ExportManifest): ExportCheck = {
+    val files = m.tables.flatMap(_.files)
+    files.foreach { f =>
+      sizeOf(checkedPath(f.path)) match {
+        case None =>
+          throw new ExportSourceException(s"$describe: missing export file ${f.path}")
+        case Some(n) if n != f.bytes =>
+          throw new ExportSourceException(
+            s"$describe/${f.path}: $n bytes present, manifest says ${f.bytes}"
+          )
+        case Some(_) => ()
+      }
+    }
+    ExportCheck(files.size, files.map(_.bytes).sum)
+  }
+
+  /** Reads every listed file in full and checks its byte count and sha256 against the manifest;
+    * fails on the first problem.
+    */
+  def verifyAll(m: ExportManifest): ExportCheck = {
+    val files = m.tables.flatMap(_.files)
+    val buffer = new Array[Byte](1 << 16)
+    files.foreach { f =>
+      val digest = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
+      val in = new DigestInputStream(open(f.path), digest)
+      var count = 0L
+      try {
+        var n = in.read(buffer)
+        while (n >= 0) { count += n; n = in.read(buffer) }
+      } finally in.close()
+      if (count != f.bytes)
+        throw new ExportSourceException(
+          s"$describe/${f.path}: $count bytes read, manifest says ${f.bytes}"
+        )
+      val hex = HexBytes.of(digest.digest())
+      if (hex != f.sha256)
+        throw new ExportSourceException(
+          s"$describe/${f.path}: sha256 $hex differs from manifest ${f.sha256}"
+        )
+    }
+    ExportCheck(files.size, files.map(_.bytes).sum)
   }

+final class S3ExportSource private (store: ObjectStore, val root: ObjectRef) extends ExportSource {
+  def describe: String = s"s3://${S3ExportSource.MaskedBucket}/${root.key}"
+  private def ref(relativePath: String) = ObjectRef(root.bucket, s"${root.key}/$relativePath")
+  protected def find(relativePath: String): Option[InputStream] =
+    store.openStream(ref(checkedPath(relativePath)))
+  protected def sizeOf(relativePath: String): Option[Long] =
+    store.head(ref(checkedPath(relativePath))).map(_.size)

+
+object S3ExportSource {
+
+  /** How the bucket of an export appears in messages and reports. */
+  val MaskedBucket = "{data-bucket}"
+
+  private val Uri = "s3://([a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]{1,61}[a-z0-9])/(.+)".r
+  private val RunSegment = "run=[0-9a-f]{32}".r
+  private val Segment = "[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._=-]*".r
+
+  /** An export at `s3://BUCKET/PREFIX/run=<32 hex>` (a trailing `/` is allowed). Messages never
+    * repeat the URI (it holds a bucket name).
+    */
+  def fromUri(store: ObjectStore, uri: String): Either[String, S3ExportSource] =
+    Option(uri).getOrElse("") match {
+      case Uri(bucket, rest) =>
+        val key = rest.stripSuffix("/")
+        val segments = key.split('/').toList
+        if (!segments.forall(Segment.matches))
+          Left("export location has an invalid key segment")
+        else if (!RunSegment.matches(segments.last))
+          Left("export location must end in run=<32 hex> (the export run directory)")
+        else Right(new S3ExportSource(store, ObjectRef(bucket, key)))
+      case _ => Left("export location is not an s3://BUCKET/PREFIX/run=<32 hex> URI")
+    }
+}
+
+/** Opens an export by location: `s3://...` through the object store, anything else as a local
+  * directory.
+  */
+object ExportSources {
+  def open(location: String, objects: Option[ObjectStore]): Either[String, ExportSource] =
+    if (location != null && location.startsWith("s3://"))
+      objects
+        .toRight("an s3:// export needs an object store (--stores)")
+        .flatMap(S3ExportSource.fromUri(_, location))
+    else {
+      val p = java.nio.file.Paths.get(Option(location).getOrElse("")).toAbsolutePath
+      if (Files.isDirectory(p)) Right(new LocalDirectorySource(p))
+      else Left(s"export directory $p does not exist")
+    }
 }
